planEntities.name: IOM NC.0129 (PAHO Migration MPTF) Strengthening capacities of border municipalities in the Brazilian Amazon to face the challenges of migration, climate change and health
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.1 Capacidades institucionais públicas e privadas fortalecidas para ampliação e melhoria de prestação de serviços básicos, incluindo redes de proteção social e a integração de serviços ecossistêmicos, de forma que sejam adaptados e mais resilientes frente aos efeitos da mudança do clima, da poluição e aos riscos de desastres, com especial atenção aos ocasionados por atividades econômicas predatórias.
planEntities.description: The main objective of this Joint Programme implemented by IOM and PAHO is to contribute to addressing the compound challenges posed by migration, climate change, and health issues and increasing access of migrants to essential health services in border municipalities in the Brazilian Amazon. This will be done by: 1) strengthening policy coherence among the migration, environment and climate change, and health areas; 2) providing capacity building for the national public healthcare system to face challenges related to climate change and international migration; and 3) strengthening community resilience in border municipalities, including cross-border indigenous peoples and other traditional communities.

planEntities.name: IOM IS.0028 Oportunidades: Economic integration of migrants in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.1 Governos nacionais e subnacionais, instituições públicas e setor privado têm suas capacidades reforçadas para formular e implementar políticas e iniciativas para promoção do desenvolvimento econômico local, da geração de renda, da ampliação da empregabilidade e garantia do trabalho decente, com foco em igualdade de oportunidades, na redução da discriminação nas relações econômicas e trabalhistas, das diferenças salariais por sexo, geração, gênero, raça, etnia ou nacionalidade, no fortalecimento dos direitos de trabalhadores, dos usuários e das comunidades afetadas pela atividade econômica, e na promoção da inclusão em condições igualitárias de mulheres, jovens, pessoas com deficiência, migrantes e pessoas refugiadas, de modo a proteger os direitos dos segmentos da população em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: This project aims to contribute to the economic integration of vulnerable nationals from Venezuela and other neighbouring countries in Brazil by ensuring access to sustainable livelihoods and employment opportunities, fostering their long-term integration and self-reliance in their host communities.

planEntities.name: IOM IM.0047 Facilitating Gender-Responsive Regular Migration Pathways through Harmonized and Coherent Laws, Policies and Practices in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.3 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para políticas públicas e programas para reduzir as múltiplas formas de criminalidade e violência contra públicos mais afetados e em situação de vulnerabilidade, com especial atenção à violência baseada em gênero e à discriminação racial e contra as juventudes, junto com a provisão de serviços de assistência social e acesso à justiça especializados para vítimas, suas famílias e comunidades.
planEntities.description: This project aims to enhance safe, orderly, and regular migration pathways for international migrants in Brazil by improving the knowledge of public authorities and stakeholders on Brazilian migration law. Key activities include creating a national platform for policy dialogue on migration law, developing a gender-sensitive Migration Law Handbook, and strengthening the capacities of government officials and practitioners in migration law.

planEntities.name: IOM DP.2952 ​Contribute to strengthening the Unified Social Assistance System in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 5.1.1 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para implementar e reforçar políticas, marcos normativos e redes de proteção social e de garantia de direitos, em todos os níveis de governo e junto à sociedade civil, para resposta emergencial, proteção e integração socioeconômica de populações atingidas por crises humanitárias e desastres, pessoas refugiadas, migrantes e apátridas, mulheres, crianças, adolescentes e demais grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e apoio às comunidades de acolhida.
planEntities.description: IOM’s proposed intervention aims to contribute to strengthening the Social Assistance System in Brazil, by supporting the federal and local governments in their capacity to provide social protection to vulnerable populations affected by multiple crises. The intervention will address the extreme climate events in Rio Grande do Sul and support the Cedar Roots (Operação Raízes do Cedro) operation in São Paulo, which provides emergency assistance to repatriated Brazilians fleeing the conflict in Lebanon.

planEntities.name: IOM RR.0401 Assisted Voluntary Return and Reintegration - ARVoRe IX
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.1 Capacidades de gestão em políticas públicas de proteção social, erradicação da pobreza, combate à fome e de empoderamento econômico fortalecidas, considerando aspectos demográficos e sociais regionalizados, com foco nos territórios, grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial jovens e mulheres que sofrem discriminações múltiplas, priorizando o desenvolvimento de estratégias de inclusão socioeconômica, incluindo a redução das desigualdades no mercado de trabalho, estimulando níveis de qualificação, empregabilidade e de renda igualitários entre homens e mulheres, abrangendo também trabalhadoras domésticas, o setor de cuidados, trabalhadores rurais e trabalhadores de aplicativos.
planEntities.description: ARVoRe IX project-aim is to support migrants of all genders, ages, abilities and other diversities willing to return to their countries of origin through a rights-based approach in a safe and dignified way and to achieve sustainable reintegration, while ultimately contributing to Portugal's migration management efforts.

planEntities.name: IOM IS.0208 Enhancing Protection, Regularization, and Socio-economic Integration of Migrants and Refugees from Venezuela and Other Relevant Nationalities in the Latin America Region
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.1 Governos nacionais e subnacionais, instituições públicas e setor privado têm suas capacidades reforçadas para formular e implementar políticas e iniciativas para promoção do desenvolvimento econômico local, da geração de renda, da ampliação da empregabilidade e garantia do trabalho decente, com foco em igualdade de oportunidades, na redução da discriminação nas relações econômicas e trabalhistas, das diferenças salariais por sexo, geração, gênero, raça, etnia ou nacionalidade, no fortalecimento dos direitos de trabalhadores, dos usuários e das comunidades afetadas pela atividade econômica, e na promoção da inclusão em condições igualitárias de mulheres, jovens, pessoas com deficiência, migrantes e pessoas refugiadas, de modo a proteger os direitos dos segmentos da população em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: This project aims to improve access to regularization and documentation processes for vulnerable migrants, strengthen protection mechanisms, and foster long-term integration of migrants into host communities in Acre and Rondônia, in northern Brazil. Particular attention will be given to border towns, such as Assis Brasil, (Acre) and Guajará-Mirim (Rondônia), where protection needs are heightened due to increased patterns of irregular migration and multiple coexisting migration routes.

planEntities.name: IOM PX.0650 Improving Reintegration Outcomes for Survivors of Modern Slavery (Phase 2)
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.5 Capacidades governamentais fortalecidas para garantir uma abordagem multidimensional para combater crimes transnacionais, em especial durante crises humanitárias, e mitigar seus impactos sobre grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, compartilhando informações e aprimorando políticas orientadas por evidências, voltadas ao respeito aos direitos humanos e baseadas na igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia.
planEntities.description: This project seeks to address these gaps by enhancing the capacities of key actors to improve voluntary return and reintegration processes and outcomes for survivors of modern slavery and human trafficking. Building on activities conducted in the first phase of the project (PX.0543), it will strengthen the understanding and capacity of key actors in the UK and in countries of return, such as Brazil. This will be done by assessing the role of police and local authorities in the voluntary return of survivors from the UK, as well as by building the capacity of key actors involved in voluntary return and reintegration and conducting or updating national mappings of available reintegration services in countries of return. Second, the project will enhance the engagement of survivors of modern slavery and human trafficking in the process of voluntary return and reintegration, to centre survivor voice and agency, by conducting lived experience research to understand the experiences of survivors who have returned, and by piloting a Virtual Orientation programme for survivors considering return from the UK, promoting survivor agency in decision making.

planEntities.name: IOM PX.0646 [MPTF Legal Amazon] Comprehensive protection and promotion of the rights of indigenous children, adolescents and young people in the Brazilian Amazon basin
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.4 Capacidades nacionais e arranjos institucionais fortalecidos para a promoção da intersetorialidade e transversalidade das políticas públicas voltadas para o enfrentamento de todas as formas de discriminação e desigualdades, em especial com base em geração, gênero, raça e etnia, e que afeta mulheres e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The project focuses promotion of the rights of indigenous children, adolescents, and young people, integrating cross-cutting initiatives such as nutrition, protection against violence (especially sexual violence), disease prevention, alongside promoting productive inclusion.

planEntities.name: IOM PX.0685 Aqui é Brasil Programme: Multisectoral strengthening of the Brazilian government's efforts for humanized reception, human rights protection, and reintegration of forcibly returned Brazilians
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description:
The project aims to ensure that forcibly returned Brazilians have access to comprehensive support and reception services upon arrival. Coordinated by IOM, in partnership with the Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship (MDHC)—as well as ther minitries and state and municipal governments, civil society, and the private sector, the initiative seeks to strengthen government protection mechanisms, facilitate socio-economic reintegration, and improve public actions for humanized reception.
The project is structured around four main pillars:
Humanized reception, protection, and emergency response at airports, ensuring immediate support and identification of specific needs.
Support for social and economic reintegration, including assistance for documentation, access to job opportunities, and support for family reunification.
Strengthening migration governance, to improve interministerial coordination, generate strategic data on the profile of returnees, and support evidence-based public policies.
Strategic partnerships and multisectoral cooperation, promoting integration among federal, state, and municipal governments, the private sector, and community organizations to ensure sustainable long-term solutions.

planEntities.name: IOM IS.0228 Strengthening Integration and Social Cohesion of Migrants and Host Communities in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.1 Governos nacionais e subnacionais, instituições públicas e setor privado têm suas capacidades reforçadas para formular e implementar políticas e iniciativas para promoção do desenvolvimento econômico local, da geração de renda, da ampliação da empregabilidade e garantia do trabalho decente, com foco em igualdade de oportunidades, na redução da discriminação nas relações econômicas e trabalhistas, das diferenças salariais por sexo, geração, gênero, raça, etnia ou nacionalidade, no fortalecimento dos direitos de trabalhadores, dos usuários e das comunidades afetadas pela atividade econômica, e na promoção da inclusão em condições igualitárias de mulheres, jovens, pessoas com deficiência, migrantes e pessoas refugiadas, de modo a proteger os direitos dos segmentos da população em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The project is a multi-donor initiative designed to provide flexible and responsive support for a wide range of activities that promote the integration and social cohesion of migrants and host communities in Brazil. It aims to strengthen access to opportunities that improve their self-sufficiency, inclusion, and overall well-being. The initiative will support a variety of interventions, including access to services, capacity-building efforts, and broader inclusion measures that address both immediate and long-term needs. Through partnerships with government entities, private sector actors, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders, this initiative will contribute to improving the overall resilience of migrants and host communities in the country.

planEntities.name: IOM PX.0651 Fair Play: Safeguarding the Youth, Raising Awareness and Strengthening Capacity to Combat Human Trafficking in Sports in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.5 Capacidades governamentais fortalecidas para garantir uma abordagem multidimensional para combater crimes transnacionais, em especial durante crises humanitárias, e mitigar seus impactos sobre grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, compartilhando informações e aprimorando políticas orientadas por evidências, voltadas ao respeito aos direitos humanos e baseadas na igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia.
planEntities.description: This project aims to contribute to safeguarding young, aspiring athletes in Brazil from the risks of trafficking within the sports sector. This will be achieved as the government authorities will have the knowledge, skills and tools to prevent human trafficking in sports in Brazil with an age-gender-sensitive and rights-based approach; communities and populations exposed to greater vulnerabilities, especially women and youth, will be equipped with up-to-date age-gender-sensitive knowledge of human trafficking in sports, and on how to report trafficking networks and perpetrators to relevant authorities; a sustainability plan will be available to government officials and key stakeholders, to sustain awareness raising efforts, protect athletes and prevent human trafficking in sports beyond project implementation. By achieving this, it is expected that the Government of Brazil will effectively prevent and counter trafficking in persons in the sports sector, in line with the Palermo Protocols.

planEntities.name: IOM DP.5699 Operation Welcome (MDS): Safeguarding essential humanitarian assistance for Migrants and Refugees in Roraima
planEntities.parentName: 5.1.1 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para implementar e reforçar políticas, marcos normativos e redes de proteção social e de garantia de direitos, em todos os níveis de governo e junto à sociedade civil, para resposta emergencial, proteção e integração socioeconômica de populações atingidas por crises humanitárias e desastres, pessoas refugiadas, migrantes e apátridas, mulheres, crianças, adolescentes e demais grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e apoio às comunidades de acolhida.
planEntities.description: This project aims to preserve critical elements of IOM's presence in Roraima and ensure continuity of essential services under Operation Welcome. The initiative will maintain legal orientation and documentation support, sustain WASH activities in spontaneous settlements outside the formal shelter system, continue facilitating safe relocation through the national relocation programme, uphold protection services with a focus on survivors of gender-based violence, victims of trafficking, unaccompanied children, and the growing number of elderly and chronically ill migrants, and safeguard the  production of reliable data through the Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM).

planEntities.name: IOM EP.0113 Tchê Prepara Project: Emergency Preparedness and Response in Vale do Taquari
planEntities.parentName: 5.1.1 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para implementar e reforçar políticas, marcos normativos e redes de proteção social e de garantia de direitos, em todos os níveis de governo e junto à sociedade civil, para resposta emergencial, proteção e integração socioeconômica de populações atingidas por crises humanitárias e desastres, pessoas refugiadas, migrantes e apátridas, mulheres, crianças, adolescentes e demais grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e apoio às comunidades de acolhida.
planEntities.description: The project aims to improve emergency preparedness and response in the Vale do Taquari Region in RS by producing detailed risk information, conducting technical training, and developing integrated preparedness plans and operational protocols through participatory approaches. These efforts will contribute to a more agile, efficient, and coordinated response in future emergencies in the state.

planEntities.name: IOM CD.0210 PROFORT SUAS Rio Doce - Strengthening Local Capacities of the Unified Social Assistance System in the Rio Doce Basin in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.1 Capacidades de gestão em políticas públicas de proteção social, erradicação da pobreza, combate à fome e de empoderamento econômico fortalecidas, considerando aspectos demográficos e sociais regionalizados, com foco nos territórios, grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial jovens e mulheres que sofrem discriminações múltiplas, priorizando o desenvolvimento de estratégias de inclusão socioeconômica, incluindo a redução das desigualdades no mercado de trabalho, estimulando níveis de qualificação, empregabilidade e de renda igualitários entre homens e mulheres, abrangendo também trabalhadoras domésticas, o setor de cuidados, trabalhadores rurais e trabalhadores de aplicativos.
planEntities.description: The project aims to contribute to strengthening the Unified Social Assistance System (SUAS) in the 49 municipalities affected by the Fundão dam collapse in the Rio Doce basin in Minas Gerais and the northern coast of Espírito Santo, enhancing its resilience and capacity to respond to long-term post-disaster vulnerabilities. The intended change is an improvement in the institutional, technical, and operational capacity of SUAS to plan, coordinate, and deliver inclusive, evidence-based, and participatory social assistance services capable of addressing the continuous social impacts of the disaster and differentiated needs, capacities and priorities of affected populations, considering age, gender, diversity, ethnicity, disability, and migration-related vulnerabilities.

planEntities.name: IOM DP.5719 SOS Minas Gerais
planEntities.parentName: 5.1.1 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para implementar e reforçar políticas, marcos normativos e redes de proteção social e de garantia de direitos, em todos os níveis de governo e junto à sociedade civil, para resposta emergencial, proteção e integração socioeconômica de populações atingidas por crises humanitárias e desastres, pessoas refugiadas, migrantes e apátridas, mulheres, crianças, adolescentes e demais grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e apoio às comunidades de acolhida.
planEntities.description: This project aims to strenghten both the humanitarian response and emergency preparedness in Minas Gerais by combining coordinated, protection‑sensitive assistance for flood‑affected populations with targeted support to local authorities to enhance disaster readiness. Through two complementary outcomes, the project ensures that affected populations receive safe, dignified and well‑coordinated assistance in temporary collective centres, while simultaneously strengthening municipal and community preparedness through improved risk information, enhanced emergency‑readiness capacities, updated operational protocols and participatory simulations to reduce future disaster impacts and reinforce preparedness and resilience

planEntities.name: IOM RR.0578 REFOCUSS 2026 - Phase 1 (AMIF-149)
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.1 Capacidades de gestão em políticas públicas de proteção social, erradicação da pobreza, combate à fome e de empoderamento econômico fortalecidas, considerando aspectos demográficos e sociais regionalizados, com foco nos territórios, grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial jovens e mulheres que sofrem discriminações múltiplas, priorizando o desenvolvimento de estratégias de inclusão socioeconômica, incluindo a redução das desigualdades no mercado de trabalho, estimulando níveis de qualificação, empregabilidade e de renda igualitários entre homens e mulheres, abrangendo também trabalhadoras domésticas, o setor de cuidados, trabalhadores rurais e trabalhadores de aplicativos.
planEntities.description: It aims to ensure voluntary, safe, and dignified return while promoting sustainable reintegration in countries of origin, with special attention to vulnerable groups. Guided by IOM's rights-based and integrated approach, the project addresses economic, social, and psychosocial dimensions of reintegration, enabling returnees to achieve self-sufficiency, stability, and well-being. To enhance reintegration sustainability, the project will finance implementing staff in five countries of origin countries, selected due to high numbers of vulnerable returnees or complex reintegration environments. Overall, by combining tailored counselling, targeted reintegration assistance, and strengthened capacity in countries of origin, this AMIF-funded and co-funded by FEDASIL project contributes to a humane and effective migration management framework, ensuring that returnees can rebuild their lives with dignity and resilience.

Brazil.name: United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean
Brazil.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: ECLAC - Strengthened institutional capacities for advancing productive development for an inclusive and sustainable future in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 1.1.2 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para aprimorar políticas públicas e modelos regulatórios de economia sustentável que favoreçam a descarbonização e a reindustrialização com vistas à agregação de valor por meio de investimentos inovadores, sustentáveis, resilientes e responsivos às questões de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e de novas tecnologias, nos setores público e privado, em especial nos setores de energia renovável, agroindústria e infraestrutura, promovendo padrões sustentáveis de consumo, produção e descarte.
planEntities.description: This project aims to support the Brazilian government in formulating, implementing, and monitoring the new policies aimed at driving a more productive, inclusive and sustainable future. The cooperation focuses on technically supporting the territorialization of the Nova Indústria Brasil (NIB) to align subnational actions with national goals, developing a data panel to track the performance of industrial sectors in relation to the ecological transformation within the context of the Ecological Transformation Plan (PTE), analyzing the impacts of the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) and other green competitiveness policies, mapping a portfolio of investments linked to the PTE, and collaborating with the Brazilian government on sustainable productive development. The project covers Brazil, benefiting public stakeholders directly and the wider public indirectly, with partnerships involving the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services, and the Casa Civil (Brazilian Office of the President's Chief of Staff).

planEntities.name: UN-HABITAT Increased the number of cities addressing poverty issues and fostering access to basic services and adequate housing in precarious settlements in Brazil using targeted evidence-based policies
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a produção de dados desagregados, indicadores, estudos e análises a partir de recortes de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e outros critérios relevantes para o enfrentamento das múltiplas dimensões da pobreza.
planEntities.description: Is focused on UN-Habitat's work with local governments in Brazil to improve their ability to collect and manage data effectively and to develop the necessary infrastructure for more efficient data gathering and reporting systems across various territorial levels. This will support better decision-making for policies and initiatives that provide essential services, promote sustainable transport, create better planning instruments, etc. The goal is to make it easier for local governments at all levels to get the information they need to plan and act in the best interest of their communities.

planEntities.name: UN-HABITAT Increased the number of cities in Brazil expanding green infrastructure and green public spaces, focusing on territories near precarious settlements and people in vulnerable situations.
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.3 Capacidades de gestão e governança consolidadas para políticas e programas voltados ao planejamento urbano integrado, sustentável, inclusivo e participativo, com vistas a cidades e territórios eficientes e resilientes adaptados à mudança do clima, socialmente inclusivos, proporcionando a ampliação da integração entre as pessoas, combatendo a poluição, diminuindo o uso dos plásticos e promovendo sua reciclagem.
planEntities.description: Focus on strengthening and increasing the network of public parks and green areas in Brazilian cities, while improving the capacities of city officials and local communities to use citywide and localized UN-Habitat methodologies.

planEntities.name: UN-HABITAT (UNOPS) Enhanced subnational governments and local population capacities to adapt communities and infrastructure to climate change, focusing on people living in precarious settlements and in vulnerable situation
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: The objective is to generate high-quality information that supports the development and refinement of public policies and evidence-based decision-making in urban improvement. This process is grounded in the principle of innovation, incorporating both disruptive and nature-based technologies. The focus is on ensuring sustainable and efficient management of natural resources, while promoting development that is both driven by community needs and centered around people's well-being.

planEntities.name: UN-HABITAT (UNDP, UNODC) Enhanced subnational governments and local population capacities to increase social integration and safety in public spaces, focusing on the needs of women and children in vulnerable situation
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.3 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para políticas públicas e programas para reduzir as múltiplas formas de criminalidade e violência contra públicos mais afetados e em situação de vulnerabilidade, com especial atenção à violência baseada em gênero e à discriminação racial e contra as juventudes, junto com a provisão de serviços de assistência social e acesso à justiça especializados para vítimas, suas famílias e comunidades.
planEntities.description: The objective is to cultivate knowledge and innovative methodologies, alongside implementing pilot actions, to enhance social prevention of crime and violence in the public sphere. This initiative places a strong emphasis on the development of high-quality urban spaces responsive to the needs of women and children, using participatory methods to ensure the inclusion of the most vulnerable populations in the process, adhering to the principle of “leaving no one behind.”

planEntities.name: UN-HABITAT Increased number of countries engaged with Brazil and UN-Habitat in South-South cooperation initiatives to improve sustainable urbanization and urban development in their country and in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.4 Capacidade do setor público e da sociedade civil fortalecida, com vistas a implementar experiências exitosas, nacional e internacionalmente, inclusive por meio da cooperação sul-sul e trilateral, para otimizar os resultados das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: This Umbrella Programme seeks to support subnational and national governments from the global south to take ownership of and implementing the urban SDG’s, adapting Brazilian proven experiences, frameworks and tools, especially those that were built with the support of UN-Habitat after 25 years of presence in the country.

planEntities.name: UN-HABITAT Enhanced subnational governments capacities to adopt frontier technologies and innovation to improve urban environment, governance, service delivery and quality of life, focusing on people living in precarious settlements and in vulnerable situation
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: It aims to improve urban sustainability and the living conditions of brazilian municipalities through a better understanding of the urban environment and the establishment and/or improvement of its public policies, plans and actions. It focus on generating data and qualified information on the urban spaces, particularly precarious settlements, proposed action strategies to strengthen strategies and policies, in addition to carrying out activities to develop the capacities of managers and public servants do use GIS and spatial data in their work targeting people in vulnerable situation

Brazil.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000458 Women have enhanced capacity to participate and influence decision-making processes
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.2 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas para ampliar o direito à participação, ao controle social e ao diálogo social, contemplando mulheres, crianças e adolescentes, e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, no que concerne à governança inclusiva, planejamento, orçamento e prestação de serviços, com foco na intersetorialidade das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description:
The proposed partnership initiative between UN Women and the Gucci CHIME contributes to the achievement of the following results of the UN Women Brazil Country Office Strategic Note 2017-2023:
Outcome 1.1 Women, particularly those facing multiple forms of discrimination, increasingly participate in decision-making processes; and influence formulation, implementation and monitoring of national and subnational laws, policies, plans and budgets.
Output 1.1.1 National and subnational governments, the parliament, political parties and the electoral management body have enhanced capacity to formulate, implement and monitor laws, policies, plans and budgets responsive to the needs of women and girls, particularly those facing multiple forms of discrimination.
UN Women shares the vision of Gucci CHIME on human rights in development cooperation and consistently promotes and applies the human-rights-based approach and SDG Leaving No One Behind principle in all its programming. The proposed partnership contributes to achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals 5: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls and SDG 16 Promote just, peaceful, and inclusive societies. To do so, it provides technical assistance to selected government bodies to increase awareness and integrate the rights of women, particularly those facing multiple forms of discrimination, in policy and decision-making.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 00108626 Brazilian Government and partners have enhanced capacities to promote gender equality in South-South Cooperation
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.4 Capacidade do setor público e da sociedade civil fortalecida, com vistas a implementar experiências exitosas, nacional e internacionalmente, inclusive por meio da cooperação sul-sul e trilateral, para otimizar os resultados das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: The Partnership Programme with the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women (UN Women) for South-South Cooperation aims to consolidate institutional capacities for the promotion of women's rights in Brazil and partner countries, as well as to support the Brazilian Cooperation Agency to incorporate gender mainstreaming in its Programmes and projects. In Brazil, UN Women has played a key role in qualifying the debate on gender equality and in promoting women's rights. This contribution has been made by public advocacy of global and regional norms that respect gender equality; technical assistance to national and subnational government institutions to comply with these standards; by capitalizing and disseminating knowledge, tools and methodologies for the promotion of women's rights; and by creating spaces for dialogue between governments, civil society and the private sector to raise the profile of the issue and promote an active and concrete intersectoral agenda for women's empowerment. This agreement benefits from the positive discourse and relies on the international commitments made publicly and internationally by Brazil and takes advantage of the accumulated Brazilian experiences in the area of promoting gender equality. It is aimed at fostering the centrality of gender equality in Brazilian cooperation and implement South-South cooperation projects that support the advancement of women's rights in Brazil and in partner countries.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000805‬ Ministry of Women has enhanced capacity to promote gender and racial equality and the end to all forms of discrimination
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: UN Women seeks to contribute to increasing the capacity of the Brazilian Ministry of Women's governance mechanisms to formulate, implement and monitor evidence-based laws, policies and plans, supported by budgets which aim to promote gender equality, women's empowerment and human rights, focusing on women facing multiple forms of discrimination. Through the transfer of technical knowledge and capacity building, the project aims to contribute to the Ministry of Women's work in promoting gender and racial equality, empowering women in their diversity and putting an end to all types of discrimination.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000458 Brazilian Ministries have enhanced capacities to promote gender, race and ethnicity equality
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: Through a direct contribution to UN Women's Strategic Note, the Open Society Foundations (OSF) will enhance UN Women's mandate and its institutional work with the Brazilian Federal Government, specifically focusing on strengthening the capacity's on mainstreaming gender, race and ethnicity of the Ministry of Women, the Ministry of Indigenous People and the Ministry of Racial Equality. The main scope of the project is to conduct researches, organize events and provide general technical assistance and advocacy to adopt, implement and monitor strategies and policies to promote women's rights, in all their diversity and within the federal level.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN (UNHCR, UNFPA) 02000560 National policies on migration, asylum, and statelessness incorporate human rights and gender equality
planEntities.parentName: 5.1.1 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para implementar e reforçar políticas, marcos normativos e redes de proteção social e de garantia de direitos, em todos os níveis de governo e junto à sociedade civil, para resposta emergencial, proteção e integração socioeconômica de populações atingidas por crises humanitárias e desastres, pessoas refugiadas, migrantes e apátridas, mulheres, crianças, adolescentes e demais grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e apoio às comunidades de acolhida.
planEntities.description: Building upon previous joint programme good practices and lessons learned, the partners seek for institutionalization of the experiences and processes through integration of human rights and gender equality in the new generation of National Policies on Migration, Asylum, and Statelessness and institutional measures for their implementation by the state. These policies will respond to the differentiated needs of refugee and migrant women and girls and other vulnerable groups of people facing multiple forms of discrimination beyond the group of Venezuelan refugees and migrants for the benefit of all groups of refugees, migrants, and asylum seekers in Brazil. The Joint Programme focuses on ensuring that all capacities developed in the last Joint Programmes evolve into public policies at the national level, reaching refugee and migrant women of all nationalities. The participating UN Agencies will specifically partner with the Ministry of Justice and Public Security and the inter-sectorial Working Group established to develop the ‘’National Policy on Migration, Asylum and Statelessness’’.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000458‬ Indigenous women have enhanced capacity to participate and influence decision-making processes
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.1 Mulheres, jovens, pessoas negras, refugiados, migrantes e apátridas, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos que sofrem discriminação e organizações da sociedade civil têm suas capacidades fortalecidas e oportunidades iguais de mobilização social e participação na formulação de leis, políticas, planos e orçamentos, para promover a justiça social, a igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e o respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: UN Women and the Austrian Embassy in Brazil celebrated a partnership agreement to strengthen work in defense of the human rights of indigenous women and girls in Brazil. The objective of the partnership is to increase the involvement of indigenous women and girls in decision-making processes to protect and defend their rights, as well as strengthen the capacity of governments to develop, implement and monitor gender-race-ethnicity sensitive policies, plans and budgets. The support of the Austrian government is crucial to ensure the continuity of the work and commitment made by UN Women Brazil over the last ten years in defense of the rights of indigenous women.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000698 Women have enhanced capacity to participate and influence decision-making processes related to climate change
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.1 Capacidades institucionais públicas e privadas fortalecidas para ampliação e melhoria de prestação de serviços básicos, incluindo redes de proteção social e a integração de serviços ecossistêmicos, de forma que sejam adaptados e mais resilientes frente aos efeitos da mudança do clima, da poluição e aos riscos de desastres, com especial atenção aos ocasionados por atividades econômicas predatórias.
planEntities.description: The project aims to address gaps and barriers related to the gender and climate change nexus, including limited capacity to integrate gender into climate change policies and plans, limited participation of women in decision-making processes, and limited access to resources and opportunities for women. By developing a baseline study report on gender and climate change, disseminating tools to integrate gender into climate change policies and plans, and increasing women's participation in decision-making processes and activities related to climate change adaptation, the project seeks to promote gender equality and transformative and innovative solutions for climate change adaptation.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000663 UN System have enhanced capacity to promote gender, race and ethnicity equality
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.4 Capacidades nacionais e arranjos institucionais fortalecidos para a promoção da intersetorialidade e transversalidade das políticas públicas voltadas para o enfrentamento de todas as formas de discriminação e desigualdades, em especial com base em geração, gênero, raça e etnia, e que afeta mulheres e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: Activities related to the implementation, monitoring and reporting of the UN Interagency Thematic Group on Gender, Race and Ethnicity (IATG-GRE) annual action plan, including the UNCT-SWAP on Gender and Race Equality action plan and the UNCT-SWAP Assessment; joint UNCT initiatives on normative frameworks and intergovernmental fora (i.e. Generation Equality Forum, CEDAW, CSW, International Decade of People of African Descent and others); and the capacity development plan on gender, race and ethnicity for the UN System.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 2000735 Brazilian Ministries have enhanced capacities to promote care systems and policies
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.3 Capacidades institucionais relacionadas às infraestruturas para o provimento de serviços e bens públicos e sistemas de proteção social universal fortalecidas, ampliando o acesso às políticas de saúde e de cuidado e às transferências de renda para todos e todas desde uma perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia, com foco nos territórios, grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: Through a direct contribution to UN Women's Strategic Note, the Open Society Foundations (OSF) will enhance UN Women's mandate and its institutional work with the Brazilian Federal Government, specifically focusing on strengthening the capacity's on mainstreaming gender, race and ethnicity of the Ministry of Women, the Ministry of Indigenous People and the Ministry of Racial Equality. The main scope of the project is to conduct researches, organize events and provide general technical assistance and advocacy to adopt, implement and monitor strategies and policies to promote care systems and policies.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000663 Brazilian Ministries have enhanced capacities to end violence against women and girls
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description: Through a direct contribution to UN Women's Strategic Note, the Open Society Foundations (OSF) will enhance UN Women's mandate and its institutional work with the Brazilian Federal Government, specifically focusing on strengthening the capacity's on mainstreaming gender, race and ethnicity of the Ministry of Women, the Ministry of Indigenous People and the Ministry of Racial Equality. The main scope of the project is to conduct researches, organize events and provide general technical assistance and advocacy to adopt, implement and monitor strategies and policies to end violence against women in all their diversity.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN Duty bearers and rights holders have enhanced capacities to promote decent work, entrepreneurship, care society, social protection, procurement, and green economy
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.1 Governos nacionais e subnacionais, instituições públicas e setor privado têm suas capacidades reforçadas para formular e implementar políticas e iniciativas para promoção do desenvolvimento econômico local, da geração de renda, da ampliação da empregabilidade e garantia do trabalho decente, com foco em igualdade de oportunidades, na redução da discriminação nas relações econômicas e trabalhistas, das diferenças salariais por sexo, geração, gênero, raça, etnia ou nacionalidade, no fortalecimento dos direitos de trabalhadores, dos usuários e das comunidades afetadas pela atividade econômica, e na promoção da inclusão em condições igualitárias de mulheres, jovens, pessoas com deficiência, migrantes e pessoas refugiadas, de modo a proteger os direitos dos segmentos da população em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: UN Women seeks with this project to economically empower the rural women pertaining to traditional communities dedicated through climate-resilient agriculture. Economically empowering rural women, particularly traditional communities’ women and improving their climate-resilience is one of UN Women’s global priorities, as well as a priority area of work in Brazil. UN Women’s experience has shown that strengthening resilience requires an integrated approach that simultaneously addresses the structural barriers rural women from traditional communities face within the context of a changing climate. UN Women therefore has identified the following priority result areas, which will require actions from a coalition of partners to achieve transformative change for traditional communities of Maranhão and Pará.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000805‬ Ministry of Women has enhanced capacity to promote women's economic empowerment
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.1 Governos nacionais e subnacionais, instituições públicas e setor privado têm suas capacidades reforçadas para formular e implementar políticas e iniciativas para promoção do desenvolvimento econômico local, da geração de renda, da ampliação da empregabilidade e garantia do trabalho decente, com foco em igualdade de oportunidades, na redução da discriminação nas relações econômicas e trabalhistas, das diferenças salariais por sexo, geração, gênero, raça, etnia ou nacionalidade, no fortalecimento dos direitos de trabalhadores, dos usuários e das comunidades afetadas pela atividade econômica, e na promoção da inclusão em condições igualitárias de mulheres, jovens, pessoas com deficiência, migrantes e pessoas refugiadas, de modo a proteger os direitos dos segmentos da população em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description:
The Brazilian Government seeks a partnership with UN Women to contribute to enhancing the governance mechanisms' capacity within the Ministry of Women to formulate, implement, and monitor evidence-based laws, policies, and plans supported by budgets to promote gender equality, empowerment, and the human rights of women. The focus lies on those belonging to groups facing multiple forms of discrimination. The project will be implemented by the Ministry of Women in partnership with UN Women between December 2023 and December 2027. 
By transferring technical knowledge and strengthening State capacities, the project aims to help the Ministry of Women to promote women's economic empowerment.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000941/00130001 Private sector companies have enhanced capacity to promote social norms
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.1 Capacidade incrementada dos setores público e privado e da sociedade civil, com vistas à implementação de abordagens de equidade com base em geração, gênero, raça, etnia, diversidade, inclusão e redução da violência, em respeito aos direitos humanos, sem deixar ninguém para trás.
planEntities.description:
Private sector companies have enhanced capacity to promote social norms through their participation in the Unstereotype Alliance. The UA is a thought and action platform that uses advertising as a force for good to drive positive change. It seeks to eradicate harmful gender-based stereotypes. The alliance is focused on empowering women in all their diversity (race, class, age, ability, ethnicity, religion, sexuality, language, education, etc.) and addressing harmful masculinities to help create a gender equal world. The Alliance brings together a powerful growing global coalition of leading industry players behind the common goal of eliminating gender bias and harmful gender stereotypes from their advertising.

The program focuses on three key strategic priorities:  

Fostering an unstereotyped culture within the business environment, with an emphasis on diversity and inclusionary practices.  

Developing principles and guidelines for businesses to adhere to in order to create progressive portrayals in advertising content that is free from stereotypes  

Driving social change through communications that raise awareness of stereotypes among the public, and to encourage action to end stereotypes and end discrimination.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000663 Women have enhanced capacity to promote social norms and to prevent and respond to multiple forms of discrimination and violence
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.1 Mulheres, jovens, pessoas negras, refugiados, migrantes e apátridas, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos que sofrem discriminação e organizações da sociedade civil têm suas capacidades fortalecidas e oportunidades iguais de mobilização social e participação na formulação de leis, políticas, planos e orçamentos, para promover a justiça social, a igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e o respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description:
UN Women will prioritize innovative methodologies and strategies to address structural inequalities, systemic oppression, patriarchal and racist social norms exacerbated by political polarization, COVID-19, socioeconomic crisis, impacts of climate change and conflicts as the key root causes of violence against women and girls, especially women human rights defenders. Promoting positive social norms, the CO will focus on addressing the causes of social exclusion and compounded discrimination, which prevent different groups of women and girls from living a life free from violence and fully realising their human rights due to their gender, race, and ethnicity, among others.  

The CO will implement multi-dimensional interventions to achieve gender transformative results through social mobilization and advocacy, integrated normative and policy advice, building capacity for the implementation of state obligations on women’s human rights. The CO will implement innovative partnership strategies and advocacy campaigns in favour of positive social norms; provide integrated normative support to design/review, enforcement and monitoring of laws and strategies to prevent and respond to multiple forms of discrimination and violence; and facilitate increased access to and availability of quality multi-sectoral services for survivors, particularly in rural and forest settings. The CO will enhance institutional capacities of women human rights defenders’ organizations, especially grassroots women's groups of indigenous, Afro-descendant and quilombola, youth, LGBTQI+, and environmental activists strengthening their agency, voice, and meaningful engagement with human rights mechanisms and the UN Treaty Bodies. In prevention and response solutions, UN Women will mobilize individuals – including men and boys – and communities for effective whole community interventions; and establish multi-stakeholder platforms with federal and subnational governments, private sector companies, media, creative industry, and the sports ecosystem for joint action to address negative social norms and attitudes. The CO will promote UN-integrated and coordinated action as a co-chair of the UNSDCF Result Group on Social Inclusion, chair of the IATG-GRE, lead agency of the United Nations Secretary General (UNSG) UNiTE campaign to End Violence against Women and of the implementation of the UNCT SWAP on Gender and Race Equality Action Plan.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000663 Women's organizations have enhanced capacity to engage with human rights mechanisms
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.1 Mulheres, jovens, pessoas negras, refugiados, migrantes e apátridas, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos que sofrem discriminação e organizações da sociedade civil têm suas capacidades fortalecidas e oportunidades iguais de mobilização social e participação na formulação de leis, políticas, planos e orçamentos, para promover a justiça social, a igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e o respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: UN Women enhances institutional capacities of women human rights defenders’ organizations, especially grassroots women's groups of indigenous, Afro-descendant and quilombola, youth, LGBTQI+, and environmental activists strengthening their agency, voice, and meaningful engagement with human rights mechanisms and the UN Treaty Bodies.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000805‬ Ministry of Women has enhanced capacity to end violence against women and all forms of discrimination
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description:
The Brazilian Government seeks a partnership with UN Women to contribute to enhancing the governance mechanisms' capacity within the Ministry of Women to formulate, implement, and monitor evidence-based laws, policies, and plans supported by budgets to promote gender equality, empowerment, and the human rights of women. The focus lies on those belonging to groups facing multiple forms of discrimination. The project will be implemented by the Ministry of Women in partnership with UN Women between December 2023 and December 2027. 
By transferring technical knowledge and strengthening State capacities, the project aims to help the Ministry of Women to promote gender and racial equality and the end to all forms of discrimination.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 02000663 National and subnational public and private institutions and the UN system have enhanced capacity to promote social norms and to prevent and respond to multiple forms of discrimination and violence
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description: In coordination with the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA), the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) UN Women will work to ensure availability of quality and accessible essential services for diverse women and girls affected by violence. In partnership with the World Bank and national statistics institutions, the CO will facilitate production and use of disaggregated data on violence against women and girls (VAWG). In partnership with the Ministries of Women and the Justice system UN Women will work to improve access to justice for diverse women, prevent feminicide, (including through the design and effective implementation of National Pact to Prevent Feminicides and the Protocol to Judge with a Gender Perspective at the national and local levels) as well as online gender-based violence and political violence. The CO will partner with the Ministries of Women, Indigenous People, Human Rights and Racial Equality to end discrimination and violence against Indigenous and quilombola women.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN 00104027 UNiTE to End Violence against Women campaign implemented
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description: UN Brazil promotes the UN Secretary-General's campaign “UNiTE to End Violence against Women by 2030” yearly and, from 20 November to 10 December, the campaign activities are implemented in support of the 16 Days of Activism to End Violence against Women and Girls. The UN Brazil campaign calls for joint efforts and initiatives to eliminate gender-based violence with intersectional approach of human rights, addressing different types and manifestation of violence and considering the specificities of the phenomenon on different groups of women and girls. It also reinforces the understanding of gender-based violence as a grave human rights violation and recognizes and calls attention to the contributions and work of gender equality movements and advocates.

planEntities.description:
The project aims to strengthen digital inclusion in Brazil with a gender perspective by funding digital inclusion activities aimed at the participation of up to 1,300 Brazilian women in
socioeconomic vulnerable situations – with special focus on refugee and migrant women and victims of violence. It is expected to facilitate women’s overcoming of the main barriers to digital inclusion -
affordability, digital literacy and skills, employability and entrepreneurship and security and welfare concerns.

planEntities.name: UNAIDS (OHCHR) Civil society and the public sector strengthened to propose and monitor protective human rights laws
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.1 Mulheres, jovens, pessoas negras, refugiados, migrantes e apátridas, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos que sofrem discriminação e organizações da sociedade civil têm suas capacidades fortalecidas e oportunidades iguais de mobilização social e participação na formulação de leis, políticas, planos e orçamentos, para promover a justiça social, a igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e o respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description:
Considering that strengthening human rights is fundamental to addressing inequalities and, therefore, promoting a more effective response to HIV/AIDS in the most marginalized populations, the main objective of the project is to ensure that the populations most affected by the epidemic have greater protection of their civil and political rights through the implementation of protective public policies at the federal and local levels, contributing to the reduction of inequalities and a better response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic.
The project was born from a demand from the federal government to strengthen the debate on human rights in different areas and the analysis of global political movements by the UN system.
Given the global movement of anti-democratic legislation and against human rights, measuring the progress and regression of laws that make key populations vulnerable goes hand in hand with monitoring a political spectrum of interest for progressive agendas.
To date, the project will cover the following axes:
· Training in responsible advocacy for civil society
· Training rounds on strengthening human rights from legislative missions
· Formulation, creation and launch of the supporting document for the protection of human rights in the legislature
· Situation room for monitoring trends in the legislature and on social media

The initiative also promotes innovation in governance practices, fostering evidence-based decision-making and digital transformation. planEntities.description: The project strengthens the institutional capacity of the São Paulo State Secretariat for Social Development (SEDS) to implement the SuperAção/SP Programme, targeting sustainable poverty reduction. It supports integrated approaches combining social protection, skills development and productive inclusion, with strengthened intersectoral and territorial coordination. Capacities of municipalities are enhanced to enable decentralized implementation. The project also promotes data-driven decision-making through the production and use of evidence for public policies. These efforts contribute to more effective, coordinated and results-oriented social development interventions in São Paulo.

planEntities.description: The project will support the establishment and operationalization of the Brazil Climate and Ecological Transformation Investment Platform (BIP) to align and scale climate finance. It will develop a prioritized pipeline of climate-positive projects aligned with national goals and strengthen coordination among public and private stakeholders. The initiative will facilitate connections between projects and investors to mobilize private capital and innovative financing mechanisms. It will also enhance governance, monitoring and transparency of climate investments. These efforts will contribute to a more efficient and scalable climate finance ecosystem in Brazil.

planEntities.name: UNDP BRA/25/012 (UNODC) Strengthened capacities and innovative approaches for integrated drug policy and asset management in Brazil

planEntities.description: The project will strengthen institutional capacities to advance integrated, rights-based drug policies and asset management in Brazil. It will develop and institutionalize innovative methodologies, including sustainable alternative development and prevention initiatives. Capacities of governmental and non-governmental actors will be enhanced to support coordinated policy implementation, including strengthening SISNAD. The project will also promote strategies to protect children and adolescents from drug-related risks and violence. These efforts will contribute to more effective, evidence-based and human rights-oriented responses to drug policy challenges.

planEntities.parentName: 3.1.2 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de estímulo à economia popular, solidária, sustentável e resiliente, a produção, consumo e descarte sustentáveis, a bioeconomia, a inovação, a pesquisa e desenvolvimento ambientalmente adequados e à criação de empregos verdes decentes e inclusivos, valorizando os saberes e modos de vida dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral e considerando os grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.

It will expand access to technical assistance and agroecological practices, enhancing productivity, income generation and environmental sustainability. Capacities of local ATER agents and rural organizations will be strengthened to support sustainable value chains and market access. Demonstration units will facilitate the adoption of innovative practices. These efforts will contribute to improved livelihoods and conservation of natural resources, including the Itaipu reservoir.

planEntities.name: UNDP BRA/25/015 – Strengthened cybersecurity, digital governance and transparency in the Brazilian Judiciary
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.1 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas de participação no controle, desenvolvimento e aplicação do marco legal de transparência, integridade, combate à corrupção, e de inovações tecnológicas no setor público, ampliando a transparência e o acesso a dados e informações sobre a oferta e a qualidade dos serviços prestados à população, e desenvolvendo soluções, baseadas nos direitos humanos e na igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia, para os desafios nacionais e locais.

It will support the development and implementation of integrated digital solutions to enhance data protection, document preservation and system interoperability. User-centered improvements will increase efficiency and reduce manual processes. These efforts will promote transparency, evidence-based decision-making and faster judicial services. The initiative contributes to a more secure, efficient and citizen-oriented justice system in Brazil.

planEntities.name: UNDP BRA/25/032 – Strengthened subnational capacities and governance for high-integrity REDD+ and sustainable forest finance in the Brazilian Amazon
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.4 Capacidades institucionais públicas e privadas fortalecidas para a internalização de custos financeiros, sociais e ambientais das ações necessárias à redução das emissões, assim como para o apoio ao desenvolvimento de investimentos e novos mecanismos de financiamento para uma economia sustentável, descarbonizada e resiliente, em especial para os povos indígenas, povos e comunidades tradicionais e populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral.
planEntities.description: The project will strengthen the technical, institutional and governance capacities of subnational jurisdictions in the Brazilian Amazon to operationalize high-integrity REDD+ systems. It will support alignment with national frameworks and international standards, including MRV systems, safeguards and carbon market requirements. Through capacity development, coordination and data systems, jurisdictions will improve readiness to access results-based forest finance. The initiative promotes inclusive participation of Indigenous Peoples and local communities and enhances transparency. These efforts will contribute to reduced deforestation and increased climate finance aligned with Brazil’s commitments.

planEntities.name: UNDRR - City-to-city cooperation for climate and disaster resilience fostered via the mentorship of the Resilience Hubs of the "Making Cities Resilient 2030" initiative
planEntities.parentName: 5.1.4 Capacidades fortalecidas dos governos, sociedade civil e organizações humanitárias para o desenvolvimento de políticas públicas e de estratégias de redução de riscos e gestão de desastres, baseadas em evidências e centradas no respeito aos direitos humanos e na igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia.
planEntities.description:
MCR2030 Resilience Hubs are cities that demonstrate excellence and leadership in areas of disaster risk reduction, resilience and climate change adaptation. Interested cities can apply to the title of MCR2030 Resilience Hub by signing with UNDRR a Joint Work Plan that aims to mentor nearby local governments seeking support in the local level implementation of the Sendai Framework. 

In 2023, Salvador (BA), Porto Alegre (RS), and Barcarena (PA) have successfully applied to the title and joined Campinas (SP) and Recife (PE) as MCR2030 Resilience Hubs in Brazil. In 2024, the five Brazilian Hubs will support at least 3 municipalities in Brazil with a series mentorship actions, including: city-to-city knowledge exchange; capacity building support to other local governments; mentoring for project planning, strengthening of metropolitan governance for DRR. Those activities will be implemented with the normative guidance and technical support of UNDRR.

planEntities.name: UNEP Promoting integrated metropolitan planning and innovative urban technology investments in Brazil - CITinova II
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.3 Capacidades de gestão e governança consolidadas para políticas e programas voltados ao planejamento urbano integrado, sustentável, inclusivo e participativo, com vistas a cidades e territórios eficientes e resilientes adaptados à mudança do clima, socialmente inclusivos, proporcionando a ampliação da integração entre as pessoas, combatendo a poluição, diminuindo o uso dos plásticos e promovendo sua reciclagem.
planEntities.description:
The main challenge addressed by this project is that Brazilian metropolitan areas are growing unsustainably, based on an inefficient development model characterized by a high degree of urban sprawl, which has several negative consequences for the environment, including high levels of GHG emissions, significant loss of biodiversity, habitat fragmentation and increased pressures on ecosystem services. This model also makes urban governance costly and complex, and ultimately degrades quality of life in urban areas.
To address the aforementioned global environmental problems that Brazil is experiencing in an urban context, this project aims to accelerate the sustainable development of Brazilian metropolitan regions, Leading lo reductions in greenhouse gas emissions and the conservation of biodiversity. To this end, the project will increase local, state and federal capacity to undertake integrated urban planning, catalyze sustainable investments and facilitate long-term and sustainable urban development. Ultimately, the project aims to contribute toa sustainable transformation of the country's urban system and its development pattern.
To ensure the achievement of its objective, this project will focus on three distinct but representative metropolitan regions in Brazil, in addition to focusing on replicating and scaling-up good practices at the national level. The three pilot metropolitan regions are:
(1) Belém Metropolitan Region (RM Belém), located in the State of Pará in the northem and Amazonian region of the country;
(2) Greater Teresina Integrated Developmeot Region (Greater Teresina RIDE), in the northeast region in the states of Piauí and Maranhão. For most activities, the project will focus on the RIDE's ptimary urban area, the Timon-Teresina Urban Agglomeration; and,
(3) Florianópolis Metropolitan Region (RM Florianópolis), located in the State of Santa Catarina, in the southern region of the country.

planEntities.name: UNEP Realizing the Biodiversity Conservation Potential of Private Lands
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description:
Half of the remaining natural vegetation cover in the five Brazilian biomes this project focuses on (Atlantic Forest, Cerrado, Caatinga, Pantanal and Pampa), amounting to 88 million hectares of natural vegetation, are located on private lands. Although a massive investment is underway to georeference these areas, with almost 70% national coverage completed, their ability to contribute to biodiversity conservation and ecosystem services provision, which is underpinned by their sustainable landscape and forest management is hindered by a lack of i) management guidelines for landscape 
stakeholders; ii) Incomplete Federal regulations on management regimes allowed on these private set-aside areas; iii) the inexistence of tools for the public sector to conduct strategic planning and management of these set-aside areas at macroscales; and iv) appropriate incentives mechanisms to influence private land-owners in priority areas to adopt practices that would improve biodiversity conservation and ecosystem services provision. This project, that has both pilot and macro policy level elements, aims to address these barriers by a)providing these missing elements, b)by piloting them on-the-ground in two Key Biodiversity Areas (KBA) (approx. 1 mi hectares) and c)via a sectorial agreement with the forestry sector to improve the management of their private set-aside areas. A successful implementation will have a direct contribution of conserving over 50 endangered species, scaling-up sustainable landscape management and appropriate systems of sustainable forest management in millions of hectares of Private Set-Aside Areas (PSAA). More importantly, it will create the basis of a national management system of conservation and management for 88 million hectares of PSAA and their wider landscapes.

planEntities.parentName: 3.2.4 Capacidades institucionais públicas e privadas fortalecidas para a internalização de custos financeiros, sociais e ambientais das ações necessárias à redução das emissões, assim como para o apoio ao desenvolvimento de investimentos e novos mecanismos de financiamento para uma economia sustentável, descarbonizada e resiliente, em especial para os povos indígenas, povos e comunidades tradicionais e populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral.
planEntities.description: This project provides technical assistance, analytical guidance, and support to Brazil and Colombia, to strengthen the capacity of target countries to implement policies geared towards scaling up finance for nature through the use of public finance instruments, with a focus on fiscal incentives reform. As a result, the project will contribute to creating an enabling policy environment for more sustainable, inclusive and resilient food, forest and land-use systems which is one of the key pillars of a green recovery in Latin America, as well as the delivery of the Paris Climate Agreement and the SDGs.

planEntities.name: UNEP Development of impact investment mechanisms and solutions for sustainability goals (Amazon, Cerrado and Chaco)
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.4 Capacidades institucionais públicas e privadas fortalecidas para a internalização de custos financeiros, sociais e ambientais das ações necessárias à redução das emissões, assim como para o apoio ao desenvolvimento de investimentos e novos mecanismos de financiamento para uma economia sustentável, descarbonizada e resiliente, em especial para os povos indígenas, povos e comunidades tradicionais e populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral.
planEntities.description: IFACC is an initiative of the the United Nations Environment Programme, The Nature Conservancy, and the Tropical Forest Alliance to significantly increase and accelerate lending and investment in sustainable agriculture in Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay. IFACC’s goal is to mobilize $10 billion in commitments and disbursements by 2030 by bringing together leading companies, banks and investors who work together to meet the need for transitional finance in the production of beef, soy, and other agricultural products without further deforestation or conversion. By the end of 2022, IFACC had $4.3 billion in commitments and disbursed $111 million.

planEntities.parentName: 3.1.4 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas sobre soberania e segurança alimentar e nutricional, seguranças sanitária, hídrica, de saneamento básico, energética e climática, combate à poluição e redução e tratamento sustentável adequado dos resíduos, para que também respondam aos desafios das áreas urbanas, rurais e suas periferias, e com perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia, respeito aos saberes e modos de vida dos povos que vivem nos territórios e foco nos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: Operationalization of the Special Programme to support insitutional strengthening at the national level to enhance the implementation of the Basel, Rotterdam and Stockholm conventions, the Minamata Convention on Mercury and the Strategic Approach to Internacional Chemicals Management.

planEntities.name: UNEP Enhancing the climate mitigation ambition of Brazil through methane integration
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: After a request from the Ministry of Environment of Brazil, CCAC will provide its support to the elaboration of the mitigation component of the Brazil 2024-2035 Climate Plan, with a higher climate ambition, a process which will inform the update of Brazil National Determined Contributions (NDC) for 2025 and prepare the country’s trajectory towards net zero emissions by 2050. As part of the mitigation component, to be supported both by CCAC and UNEP Copenhagen Climate Center, Brazil aims to elaborate sectoral mitigation plans to lay down the pathway to achieve the country’s climate commitment, particularly the integration of methane as a short-lived climate pollutant (SLCP), alongside other greenhouse gas (GHG). The project ensures methane reduction consideration is mainstreamed into overall's Climate Plan by looking integration across sectors and the co-benefits of measures for adaptation and other sustainable development goals. As a signatory of the Global Methane Pledge, Brazil committed to the global goal of 30% of methane reduction by 2030 and expressed interest to strengthen methane in its NDC revision aligned with country's climate change policy framework.
