planEntities.description: The project is aimed at facilitating the ratification and early implementation of the Minamata Convention by providing key national stakeholders in Brazil with the scientific and technical knowledge and tools needed for that purpose Brazil will benefit from new and updated information about the mercury cycle in the country and building capacity in managing the risks of mercury. The sharing of experiences and lessons learned throughout the project is also expected to be an important contribution to other similar countries.

planEntities.name: UNEP Sustainable protection and restoration of rivers, wetlands, and lakes through integrated, sustainable watershed management planning in Brazil and India
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description:
This project aims to achieve efficient and balanced use of freshwater resources at a watershed scale in two target watersheds (in Brazil and India) and guidance for integrated, sustainable watershed management plans are endorsed for global application. 
Objectives: 
•	Relevant stakeholders have ownership, engagement and are leading implementation of integrated, sustainable watershed management plans
•	A replicable and scalable approach for the creation of integrated, sustainable watershed management plans across regions and countries is endorsed by the scientific community

planEntities.name: UNEP Strengthening the national transparency system in Brazil under the Paris Agreement (DataClima+)
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: This Capacity Building Initiative for Transparency (CBIT) project aims to strengthen Brazil's climate transparency system to meet the ETF requirements under the Paris Agreement. Through DataClima+, Brazil will formalize and streamline the governance of climate data required to comply with ETF requirements and to inform decision-making, thus addressing Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) challenges reported in previous National Communications.  To produce high-quality climate information, the country will improve and optimize its climate data management cycle, including as related to planning, data collection, data processing and analysis, information publishing and sharing, data preservation, and data reuse. Thus, the project will develop and implement policies, rules, processes, organizational structures, and technologies following the best practices of governance and business process management, with standardized, well-documented procedures that serve as the basis of the organizational knowledge management approach, increasing the system’s efficiency and, more importantly, MCTI’s productivity in preparing subsequent transparency reports. Moreover, the project will implement the institutional arrangements required for the timely reception of raw data and provide the capacity building required to ensure that key stakeholders benefit from the newly developed information system.

planEntities.name: UNEP Initiative for Climate Action Transparency (ICAT) Brazil - Elaboration of sectoral mitigation plans  under the Brazilian National Plan on Climate Change
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description:
To collaborate on the actiities related to the update of the Brazilian National Plan on Climate Change - Plano Clima, that subsequently will support the work regarding the NDC update, including support to the following activities: 
* Support on the elaboration of three mitigation plans: land use change, industry and cities
* Support on the establishment of the institutional arrangements for a national MRV system for tracking implementation of the National Mitigation Strategy and its sectoral plans

planEntities.name: UNEP Partnership for Action on Green Economy
planEntities.parentName: 1.1.4 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para adoção de políticas macroeconômicas, incluindo fiscal, monetária e cambial, e políticas estruturais e setoriais que promovam o crescimento econômico sustentável e a transformação produtiva com pleno emprego, estabilidade monetária, justiça social e ambiental.
planEntities.description: The Partnership for Action on Green Economy (PAGE), launched in 2013, is a joint initiative by five United Nations agencies designed to support countries in transitioning to an Inclusive Green Economy (IGE). The Partnership for Action on Green Economy (PAGE) in Brazil supports the Ministry of Finance in the implementation of the Ecological Transformation Plan (ETP), launched in 2023, and collaborates with other ministries such as the Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services (MDIC) in the National Circular Economy Strategy (ENEC). Since 2024, PAGE is supporting Brazil to implement new policies that embed environmental concerns in long-term growth and promotes the ecological transformation towards a greener and inclusive development.

planEntities.name: Develop a National Short-lived Climate Pollutant Action Plan
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: The project supports the Brazilian Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MMA) in developing a National SLCP Plan through a structured planning process led by the Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI). The plan is built around three pillars: robust evidence on SLCP emissions and mitigation benefits; broad stakeholder engagement across government, civil society, and the private sector; and integration of SLCP measures into existing national planning frameworks, particularly the National Climate Plan and the 2025 NDC update. The project is coordinated within MMA by the Secretariat of Urban Environment and Environmental Quality (SQA/MMA) in cooperation with the Secretariat for Climate Change (SMC/MMA).

planEntities.name: UNEP Develop a Methane Mitigation Strategy For Urban and Agricultural Waste Sectors
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: The project supports the Brazilian government in developing and adopting a comprehensive Methane Reduction Strategy for urban and agricultural waste sectors. In collaboration with MMA and MAPA, the project combines research, stakeholder engagement, and technical assistance to design integrated roadmaps for sustainable waste management. It also supports sub-national agencies in implementing new waste management practices through guidebooks, training, and technical assistance, and develops a proposal for incorporating the strategy into existing national policies. The initiative contributes to Brazil's Global Methane Pledge commitments and complements related CCAC-supported processes such as the National SLCP Plan and the Plano Clima.

planEntities.name: UNEP Reducing Methane Emissions Intensity from the Livestock Sector
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: The project works with Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAPA) to develop and implement strategies for reducing methane emission intensity in the livestock sector, within the framework of the ABC+ Plan. It ffocuses on three interconnected workstreams: elaborating a programmatic strategy for methane mitigation in beef ranching; developing and integrating an MRV framework into the ABC+ Plan Information System (SINABC); and engaging approximately 3,000 farmers through Technological Reference Units (TRUs), seminars, and field days to promote the adoption of low-carbon livestock practices such as pasture recovery, crop-livestock-forestry integration, and improved feeding regimens.

planEntities.name: UNEP Develop a Vehicle Emissions Inspection Programme
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.2 Capacidade de gestão local fortalecida, com ênfase em prevenção, preparação, mitigação e estabelecimento de respostas rápidas e duradouras para proteção das comunidades e grupos vulneráveis à mudança do clima e desastres ambientais, que respondam às necessidades e às especificidades dos biomas e com ênfase em seus patrimônios naturais, culturais e respeitem o direito à vida, à integridade física e à saúde das populações afetadas.
planEntities.description: The project supports Brazil's Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MMA) in reducing short-lived climate pollutants (black carbon, PM 2.5, and sources of tropospheric ozone) from road vehicles through two complementary workstreams. The International Council on Clean Transportation (ICCT) leads the development of national vehicle inspection guidelines, state-of-the-art analysis of inspection technologies, and a practical guide for subnational governments to implement heavy-duty vehicle inspection programmes, alongside engagement with potential financiers for a pilot project. The Institute of Energy and Environment (IEMA) leads the update of Brazil's road emissions inventory (last produced in 2013) and the development of a web-based platform for automatic emissions calculations and data dissemination, enabling both federal and state governments to monitor and act on vehicle emission data.

planEntities.name: UNEP Supporting the Market Transformation to a Climate-Friendly and Energy Efficient Air-Conditioning (RAC) Sector in Brazil by Establishing Regulations for Commercial Air-Conditioning to Mitigate SLCPs Emissions
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.3 Capacidades institucionais e das comunidades e grupos expostos a riscos de sofrer os impactos da mudança do clima fortalecidas, tendo em vista o aprimoramento contínuo dos diversos setores socioeconômicos brasileiros, incluindo a harmonização com padrões e boas práticas de sustentabilidade, resiliência, descarbonização e incentivos à produção, ao consumo e descarte sustentáveis.
planEntities.description: The project supports Brazil's Ministry of Mines and Energy (MME) in developing a Cooling Efficiency Strategy for the commercial air conditioning sector, focused on reducing short-lived climate pollutants (particularly HFCs) through the establishment of minimum energy performance standards (MEPS) and voluntary labelling programmes. The project builds on an existing Regulatory Impact Assessment for commercial ACs and aligns with Brazil's commitments under the Kigali Amendment and the Global Cooling Pledge.

planEntities.name: UNEP Establish standardized national guidelines for small-scale composting, harmonizing subnational regulations and promoting best practices in organic waste management
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.3 Capacidades institucionais e das comunidades e grupos expostos a riscos de sofrer os impactos da mudança do clima fortalecidas, tendo em vista o aprimoramento contínuo dos diversos setores socioeconômicos brasileiros, incluindo a harmonização com padrões e boas práticas de sustentabilidade, resiliência, descarbonização e incentivos à produção, ao consumo e descarte sustentáveis.
planEntities.description: The project aims to update the Technical Bulletin "Technical Criteria for Designing, Operating, and Monitoring Small-Scale Composting Yards" incorporating subnational regulations and national guidelines. This Bulletin will provide technical backing for municipalities to implement organic waste management systems, diverting this fraction from landfills. The initiative promotes organic waste recycling, methane emission reduction and decentralized waste treatment, aligning with Brazil’s National Solid Waste Policy.

planEntities.name: UNEP Programme for a circular model of waste management in Birigui
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.3 Capacidades institucionais e das comunidades e grupos expostos a riscos de sofrer os impactos da mudança do clima fortalecidas, tendo em vista o aprimoramento contínuo dos diversos setores socioeconômicos brasileiros, incluindo a harmonização com padrões e boas práticas de sustentabilidade, resiliência, descarbonização e incentivos à produção, ao consumo e descarte sustentáveis.
planEntities.description:
The objective is to create a logical and practical structure, as well as a roadmap for local government, with reflections also at the subnational and national levels. The proposal will help identify solutions and mobilize resources to reduce waste generation, increase waste recovery as a resource, and ensure proper management.
The project also aims to address the root causes of poor waste management, considering the additional social, economic, and environmental benefits that can arise from this transition.

planEntities.name: UNEP 106 UNODC Promotion of Information, Policy, and Education to Address Environmental Crime in the Legal Amazon (INPOED)
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: The project seeks to strengthen environmental governance, information, policy dialogue, and education to address environmental crime in the Legal Amazon through institutional cooperation, stakeholder engagement, and capacity-building activities involving local communities, religious leaders, Indigenous Peoples, and partner institutions.

planEntities.name: UNEP Making the economic case for enhancing agrobiodiversity governance through the promotion of agroecological farming practices
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: This project is concerned with measuring the current state of agrobiodiversity and making the economiccase for the adoption of agroecological practices which enhance agrobiodiversity.  The project will make the economic case for agroecology based on the value of (1) enhanced flows of ecosystem services from natural capital, especially agrobiodiversity, (2) improvements in dietary outcomes which contribute to human capital, and (3) the increases in social capital via community networks cultural heritage.

planEntities.name: UNEP Brazilian Sustainable Taxonomy (BST) Phase II
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.4 Capacidades institucionais públicas e privadas fortalecidas para a internalização de custos financeiros, sociais e ambientais das ações necessárias à redução das emissões, assim como para o apoio ao desenvolvimento de investimentos e novos mecanismos de financiamento para uma economia sustentável, descarbonizada e resiliente, em especial para os povos indígenas, povos e comunidades tradicionais e populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral.
planEntities.description: Support the Ministry of Finance of Brazil with the development of the sectoral technical annexes for the second edition of the Brazilian Sustainable Taxonomy, which include: (i) activity-based technical screening criteria for (a) "substantial contribution" for the objectives 3: Conservation, Restoration, and Sustainable Use of Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services; 4: Conservation, Sustainable Management and Use of Soil and Forests; and 6: Transition to a Circular Economy and “conservation, sustainable management and use of soil and forests” and (b) "do no significant harm" for all the environmental objectives included in the BST, and supplementary technical reports for the Brazil’s Sustainable Taxonomy related to the eight economic sectors: Agriculture, Livestock, Forest Production, Fishing and Aquaculture; Extractive industries; Manufacturing; Electricity and Gas; Water, Sanitation, Waste Management and Decontamination; Construction; Transport, Storage and Mail; Social services for quality of life and planning (Tourism, Urban Planning and Information and Communications Technology -  ICT).

planEntities.description: The Criança Esperança Programme is a multi-stakeholder partnership promoted by Globo TV and UNESCO. It is a multi-donor Social Mobilization and Fundraising Campaign, which has been promoted for the past 29 years. It provides technical and financial support to social projects implemented by NGOs in all regions of Brazil. Its main immediate objective is to promote social inclusion, educational qualification and to guarantee human rights to socially vulnerable populations.

planEntities.parentName: 1.2.2 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para aprimorar políticas de transição positiva da escola para o mundo do trabalho, voltadas aos projetos de vida de crianças, adolescentes e jovens a partir da perspectiva de gênero, raça e etnia, com sua maior participação na tomada de decisões, para melhor inserção no mercado de trabalho, a fim de aumentar as oportunidades de formação profissional e sociocultural, a produtividade e fomentar o empreendedorismo e o cooperativismo ambientalmente referenciados.
planEntities.description: This project aims to benefit, through educational activities, secondary education students, of all genders, enrolled in Brazilian public schools, in themes focused on the development of entrepreneurship, aiming at achieving an emancipatory and transforming education. The activities foreseen in this project will be carried out face-to-face and at distance, using digital platforms, comprising courses, workshops, lectures, seminars, and conversation circles, with the provision of videos and educational material.

The target audience of this project are students, teachers, school community, and education personnel.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 570BRZ1019 Rule of law strengthened through education, promotion of a culture of legality, and respect for human rights
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.1 Capacidade incrementada dos setores público e privado e da sociedade civil, com vistas à implementação de abordagens de equidade com base em geração, gênero, raça, etnia, diversidade, inclusão e redução da violência, em respeito aos direitos humanos, sem deixar ninguém para trás.
planEntities.description: The project aims to boost the transformative power of education to support and encourage vulnerable communities in the North and Northeast regions of Brazil, in the particular states of Pernambuco, Amazonas, Pará, and Roraima, to be valid and constructive members of society through non-formal education actions. The actions, which will be developed within the scope of non-formal education, will focus on three main axes: 1. Culture of legality; 2. Role of education in promoting the rule of law; 3. Reduction of gender inequalities

planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: This UNESCO cross-cutting 3-year project is focused on fostering local sustainable development, promoting human rights and preserving the historical and intangible heritage affected by the dam collapse (2015) in the region of the city of Mariana (based in the vicinities of Ouro Preto, coincidentally a World Heritage Site since 1980). The project shall also involve the experience of UNESCO's International Hydrological Programme (IHP) and the MaB programme, in actions of participatory water monitoring and preservation of local biodiversity.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 570RLA4000 Rio de Janeiro National Museum recovered

planEntities.description: The project is part of the Global Project "Museu Nacional Vive" and continues the work carried out for the restoration of the Paço São Cristóvão and the reconstruction of the National Museum through the project 914BRZ1075, with the Ministry of Education. The planned strategies and inputs aim at the restoration of the Palace and attached structures, as well as technical studies and interventions for the implementation of the Museum, considering UNESCO instruments and the premises contained in the Project "Museu Nacional Vive", established in the Governance Structure signed in 17 December 2019 between the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ), Fundação Vale and UNESCO.

planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.

planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to promote Brazilian higher education by improving innovative actions implemented by the Ministry of Education's Secretariat of Higher Education (SESu). The project proposal consists in expanding new methodologies for teachers' and managers' training; studies evaluating access, permanence and insertion in the labor market; improvement of health residency programs; incentive to improve academic-institutional management; and strategies internationalization for higher education.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1115 Strategies and Tools for Monitoring and Evaluating the Implementation of Public Educational Policies developed according to the Goals of the National Education Plan - PNE and the Articulated Action Plan - PAR

planEntities.description: This Project aims to improve the institutional capacity of the Management, Articulation and Educational Projects Department (DIGAP), at the National Education Development Funs (FNDE) through the review of processes, provision of subsidies for the review of standards, and definition of strategies for improving effectiveness in the application of education resources, with regard to infrastructure of schools and educational spaces, education staff training, and acquisition of teaching material. The proposed results should contribute to the improvement of these educational policies and, as a consequence, reduce educational inequality and achieve better access and learning rates for Brazilian students.

planEntities.description:
"This Technical Cooperation Project aims to implement innovative strategies and develop new Combined Prevention strategies and digital education in the fight against STI/HIV/AIDS, mainly for the most vulnerable and priority populations, with the prevention, information, and education actions aimed at reducing transmission of HIV and other STIs.
The project hopes there will be a reduction in the number of cases of transmission of HIV and other Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs), mainly in the most vulnerable populations, especially trans and transvestites, gays, and other men who have sex with men (MSM)."

planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: The objective of this project is to provide techical advisory services to ADASA to enable the Agency to work with the Government of the Federal District in the preparation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of the 8th edition of the World Water Forum,

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ2024 STI and economic public policies promoted in the state of Goiás through the development of the technological parks and the local ecosystem of innovation
planEntities.parentName: 1.2.1 Governos nacionais e subnacionais, instituições públicas e setor privado têm suas capacidades reforçadas para formular e implementar políticas e iniciativas para promoção do desenvolvimento econômico local, da geração de renda, da ampliação da empregabilidade e garantia do trabalho decente, com foco em igualdade de oportunidades, na redução da discriminação nas relações econômicas e trabalhistas, das diferenças salariais por sexo, geração, gênero, raça, etnia ou nacionalidade, no fortalecimento dos direitos de trabalhadores, dos usuários e das comunidades afetadas pela atividade econômica, e na promoção da inclusão em condições igualitárias de mulheres, jovens, pessoas com deficiência, migrantes e pessoas refugiadas, de modo a proteger os direitos dos segmentos da população em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The project intends to help the Brazilian state of Goias to implement its mid-term STI strategy for 2020-2023 by the enhancement of the technical capacity of the seven existing technological parks of the state (parques tecnológicos) as important drivers for local sustainable development.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ2026 Brazilian National Sanitary Surveillance Agency (ANVISA) technology and communication capacities improved
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.4 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de saúde, soberania e segurança alimentar e nutricional fortalecidas, com foco na produção ambientalmente adequada, no acesso igualitário, na qualidade e na ação intersetorial, de forma inclusiva e protetiva para todas as pessoas, em especial as que estão em situação de vulnerabilidade, a partir das perspectivas de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e do respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: The project is intended to enable new scientific and technological improvements for the Brazilian National Sanitary Surveilance Agency (ANVISA), capacity-building and training opportunities to its technical staff and the development of communication sanitary campaigns and other anti-COVID initiatives.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3047 Public policies for the rights of elderly people promoted and enhanced
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.1 Capacidade incrementada dos setores público e privado e da sociedade civil, com vistas à implementação de abordagens de equidade com base em geração, gênero, raça, etnia, diversidade, inclusão e redução da violência, em respeito aos direitos humanos, sem deixar ninguém para trás.
planEntities.description: The decline in fertility rates in Brazil in the last decade has had profound implications upon the demographic trend of its pyramid with a clear trend towards a growing elderly population. If the current trend continues, the Brazilian Institute of Statistics and Geography (IBGE) estimates that by 2050, the age segment above 60 will represent 30% of the total Brazilian pokpulation. The present project intends to provide a UNESCO cross-sectoral and technical contribution in domains (e.g. lifelong learning, education for all, access to culture and scientific progress, media literacy etc) that could improve the quality of life of the Brazilian fast-aging population, which is often victim of human rights violations (family abuse, domestic violence, etc) and neglected in the design of public policies. The increase in the life expectancy of Brazilians also represents an issue for consideration as it requires anticipation and foresight in public planning and expenditure (increased demand for health services, lifelong education opportunities etc).e.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3050 Public policies on human rights and culture of peace of the city of São Paulo improved through Innovation for human rights education
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.3 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para políticas públicas e programas para reduzir as múltiplas formas de criminalidade e violência contra públicos mais afetados e em situação de vulnerabilidade, com especial atenção à violência baseada em gênero e à discriminação racial e contra as juventudes, junto com a provisão de serviços de assistência social e acesso à justiça especializados para vítimas, suas famílias e comunidades.
planEntities.description: The following project is a partnership between the Human Rights and Citizenship Secretariat (Secretaria de Direitos Humanos e Cidadania de Sao Paulo) and the UNESCO Brasilia Office. The project is expected to improve the city policies on human rights and culture of peace by reinforcing the concept of "right to the city" and also reinforcing the transversality of human rights throughout all city secretariats, particularly the municipal education secretariat.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3051 Social development policies to promote citizenship actions in Brazil strengthened
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.2 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas para ampliar o direito à participação, ao controle social e ao diálogo social, contemplando mulheres, crianças e adolescentes, e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, no que concerne à governança inclusiva, planejamento, orçamento e prestação de serviços, com foco na intersetorialidade das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: This project intends to support the consolidation of social development policies for the promotion and strengthening of citizenship in Brazil, through the improvement of programs and services, managerial tools and technologies.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3052 Social development policies strengthened in the state of Goias
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: This project aims to contribute to consolidating and improving public policies for children, adolescents and youth of the state of Goiás, promoting rights that ensure opportunities for their full development.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3053 Capacity-building opportunities provided for youth population of Rio de Janeiro
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.1 Capacidade incrementada dos setores público e privado e da sociedade civil, com vistas à implementação de abordagens de equidade com base em geração, gênero, raça, etnia, diversidade, inclusão e redução da violência, em respeito aos direitos humanos, sem deixar ninguém para trás.
planEntities.description: This 48-month (five calendar years) project will support the municipality of Rio de Janeiro (Brazil) with innovative social methodologies to address the current challenges of its young population estimated in nearly 1,5 million inhabitants. The project will also provide training and other capacity-building opportunities fully described in the project attachments.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ4019 Cultural and Linguistic Heritage of Indigenous peoples recently contacted and of indigenous peoples living near borders in the Amazon region safeguarded
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.1 Capacidade incrementada dos setores público e privado e da sociedade civil, com vistas à implementação de abordagens de equidade com base em geração, gênero, raça, etnia, diversidade, inclusão e redução da violência, em respeito aos direitos humanos, sem deixar ninguém para trás.
planEntities.description: This project aims to develop safeguard actions to protect the cultural and linguistic heritage of indigenous peoples living near borders in the Amazon region with another Latin America countries, with special attention to indigenous people who were recently contacted.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ4024 Sustainable development policies strengthened to better promote tourism in cultural and natural heritage sites, and creative economy
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.2 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de estímulo à economia popular, solidária, sustentável e resiliente, a produção, consumo e descarte sustentáveis, a bioeconomia, a inovação, a pesquisa e desenvolvimento ambientalmente adequados e à criação de empregos verdes decentes e inclusivos, valorizando os saberes e modos de vida dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral e considerando os grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The project pursues to promote the strengthening of the governmental policy for the development of tourism, through the valorization of the cultural and natural heritage, creative economy and other transversal policies, based on the intersectoral and interinstitutional articulation. Also it aims to promote creativity and diversity, and the achievement of a diversification of the national tourism, and the implementation of the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals Agenda.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ4025 Public culture policies in the city of Niterói strengthened from a cross-cut perspective
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.3 Capacidades das instituições públicas fortalecidas para o planejamento governamental estratégico, integrado e participativo com vistas à convergência das ações de Estado e à integração de suas funções estruturantes, com foco na melhoria do acesso a bens e serviços públicos de qualidade, especialmente por grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The project aims to promote the strengthening and modernization of public culture policies in the city of Niterói, considering culture as a cross-cutting and structuring subject, based on the principles of valuing cultural citizenship, broad access to cultural goods and services, encouraging creative economy and preservation of cultural and natural heritage. The objective of the Project is also to contribute to the development of creative industries, youth training, participation in cultural life and the integration of culture in the sustainable urban development policies, in line with the 2030 Agenda.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ5017 Public Municipal Administration on innovation strengthened
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The Project aims to strengthen a municipal policy of innovation and modernize public service provision through improved communication channels with the citizens. The technical cooperation will diagnose, analyze, and plan initiatives that are specific to the development of innovation indicators and the management of information through TICs in the municipality of São Paulo, to promote the strategic use of innovation by the Municipal Secretariat of Innovation and Technology of the municipality of São Paulo as a tool to improve public municipal administration and improve the provision of services to citizens.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ5018 Public policies on consumers' protection improved in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The project aims to improve the management of information and knowledge of Brazilian National System of Consumer Protection through institutional strengthening of the National Secretariat of Consumers, also by improving public policies aimed at improving consumer protection Brazil and promoting the National Plan of Consumption and Citizenship.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ5019 Public Policies for Telecommunications and Radio Broadcasting strengthened
planEntities.parentName: 4.2.2 Gestão pública participativa e fortalecida, baseada em evidências e dados desagregados, com o estabelecimento de estratégias de elaboração, execução, monitoramento e avaliação participativa de políticas públicas, e com atenção aos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The Ministry of Communications in Brazil main attribution is to plan and define the country's public communications policies, including broadcasting, Telecommunications, Portal Services and the federal government's communication policy. The constant technological evolution challenges the State to keep its regulatory framework up to date. In Cooperation with UNESCO the project will focus on strenthening institutional capacity observing international standards and trends in order to promote inclusive communication policies and information for all.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3054 Governance and compliance of the State of Goiás improved based on ethical standards
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.1 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas de participação no controle, desenvolvimento e aplicação do marco legal de transparência, integridade, combate à corrupção, e de inovações tecnológicas no setor público, ampliando a transparência e o acesso a dados e informações sobre a oferta e a qualidade dos serviços prestados à população, e desenvolvendo soluções, baseadas nos direitos humanos e na igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia, para os desafios nacionais e locais.
planEntities.description: This Project aims to create the necessary conditions for the process of implementation and dissemination of the principles of compliance and integrity in the context of the Public Administration of the State of Goiás. With the leading role and leadership of the State Comptroller General – body of internal control linked directly to the state Executive Branch, the project intends to leverage the State of Goiás as a reference in the adoption of procedures to improve its governance instruments, transparency and efficiency in decision-making by part of public power. To this end, UNESCO aims to build a normative framework based on the following axes: 1) Ethics and Accountability; 2) Transparency; 3) Governance and Risk Management; and 4) Citizen Participation. In this way, a series of good practices shall be developed, with the potential to be raised to the level of reference and guiding compass for replicability and application in other contexts of local governments that seek to improve their decision-making processes, the structuring of mechanisms of governance and bringing citizens closer to public authorities.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ5020 Rights in the digital environment protected and promoted through the promotion of access to information, and prevention of misinformation
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.2 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas para ampliar o direito à participação, ao controle social e ao diálogo social, contemplando mulheres, crianças e adolescentes, e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, no que concerne à governança inclusiva, planejamento, orçamento e prestação de serviços, com foco na intersetorialidade das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: The Project aims to contribute to the protection and promotion of rights in the digital environment, based on strategies aimed at expanding media education, promoting freedom of expression and combating misinformation and hate speech, strengthening and sustainability of interest journalism public and the promotion of diversity and pluralism of voices on networks.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 570BRZ1020 Free and accessible education promoted through the consolidation of "Educação Livre" Platform
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to promote free access to quality education by expanding and improving the EduLivre social technology platform. It seeks to revise its content and methodologies in an accessible, attractive and entertaining way, in order to contribute to the proficiency of competences and skills for the 21st century world of work, with a main focus on socio-emotional development, entrepreneurship, and the areas of languages, mathematics and natural sciences. The initiative also seeks to develop an ecosystem that connects various players to generate study and work opportunities for Brazilian youth, as well as promoting the creation of communities and communication strategies that generate engagement, scalability and sustainability for the Project's actions.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1154 Assessments on education improved
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to improve tools, metrics and indicators used in educational assessments, in its various teaching levels and modalities: from childhood education to higher education and professional education. It is proposed that the National Institute of Educational Studies and Research Anísio Teixeira (Inep), the institution responsible for carrying out the assessments, can act in identifying improvement needs; in conducting studies that identify the best evaluation experiences; in the improvement of evaluation instruments and measures; and promoting innovation in public policies in education.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1019 Brazilian National Environmental Education Strategy strengthened
planEntities.parentName: 3.2.3 Capacidades institucionais e das comunidades e grupos expostos a riscos de sofrer os impactos da mudança do clima fortalecidas, tendo em vista o aprimoramento contínuo dos diversos setores socioeconômicos brasileiros, incluindo a harmonização com padrões e boas práticas de sustentabilidade, resiliência, descarbonização e incentivos à produção, ao consumo e descarte sustentáveis.
planEntities.description: This project aims to improve national strategies for implementing Environmental Education Policies and Programmes through the institutionalisation and mainstreaming of Environmental Education (EE) in multiple national-level plans and programmes, starting with those managed by the Ministry of the Environment. This strategy will be strengthened through activities that seek to dialogue with the axes of the National Environmental Education Programme (ProNEA): (1) Management and Planning of Environmental Education, (2) Training in Environmental Education, (3) Communication for Environmental Education - Educommunication (4) Monitoring and evaluation of environmental education policies, programmes and projects, with the expansion of social participation in the formulation and monitoring of public environmental policies.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1155 Inclusive education strengthened in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to strengthen the programs and actions of the Secretariat for Continuing Education, Youth and Adult Literacy, Diversity and Inclusion (Secadi/MoE), promoting equity and acknowledging diversity in all education modalities and levels. Focus is given on: 1) bilingual education for the deaf people, 2) special from an inclusive perspective, 3) traditional communities (quilombolas), 4) rural education, 5) indigenous education, and 6) youth and adults education. The project has transversal achievements in human rights, education for ethnic-racial relations, environmental education and the target-audiences on education for youth and school inclusion of children and adolescents beneficiaries of the Bolsa Família Program.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ5067 Meaningful connectivity and Artificial Intelligence disseminated to ensure inclusion
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.2 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas para ampliar o direito à participação, ao controle social e ao diálogo social, contemplando mulheres, crianças e adolescentes, e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, no que concerne à governança inclusiva, planejamento, orçamento e prestação de serviços, com foco na intersetorialidade das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: This project aims to promote the inclusion of vulnerable groups, including youth, in Brazil by providing them with meaningful connectivity. It also seeks to encourage the responsible use of AI by key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem with Open Data policies and Open Access to Information. As AI applications have significantly transformed the telecommunications scenario, it is important to anticipate trends and assess the impacts of new technologies, providing information to expand understanding of the benefits and impacts of these changes, highlighting the importance of Open Access to Information and Open Data. With the development of studies and research, innovative applications and changes in regulation can be encouraged considering Open Access to Information, Open Data policies and ethical standards.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ4027 National capacities strengthened to protect and promote historic heritage through the Growth Acceleration Programme (PAC)
planEntities.parentName: 1.1.4 Capacidades institucionais fortalecidas para adoção de políticas macroeconômicas, incluindo fiscal, monetária e cambial, e políticas estruturais e setoriais que promovam o crescimento econômico sustentável e a transformação produtiva com pleno emprego, estabilidade monetária, justiça social e ambiental.
planEntities.description: This project aims to support the National Institute of Historic and Artistic Heritage (IPHAN) in the process of resuming and adapting the Growth Acceleration Program (PAC) for investments in the protection and promotion of Historic Heritage for the sustainable development. The project will contribute to the implementation of innovative strategies and instruments, developing capacities of actors that will compose and participate in the shared management of the Program.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1156 Coordination between Brazilian States enhanced to implement the National Education System and its Education Plan
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to contribute with studies, analyses, and references for the implementation of the National Education System in order to ensure coordination between federated entities and the implementation of the collaboration regime from a perspective of social participation in the design of public education policies. In this sense, the project aims to ensure that the National Education System and the new National Education Plan (PNE) are articulated with state, district, and municipal education plans through PNE goals and strategies. The project also aims to provide technical inputs for improving education policies related to education democratic management, education financing, and the structuring of careers, remuneration, and work relations of education personnel.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1157 Public and quality education strengthened to promote citizenship and sustainability
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to generate knowledge and data to support the Brazilian Government in planning and developing educational policies that contribute to making the future of education in Brazil more inclusive, equitable, and of high quality, while promoting citizenship, democracy, and sustainability. The results obtained should assist the Ministry of Education in strengthening public and quality education, in developing studies and producing scientific evidence for education governance, and in implementing innovative, inclusive, equitable, and high-quality actions for all.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3057 "Dial 138": Mechanisms to receive formal racism reports developed to protect the rights of the Brazilian Black Population
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description: This project seeks to strengthen the development of public policies aimed at promoting and defending the rights of the Brazilian Black Population. The project is the first partnership between UNESCO and the Brazilian Ministry of Racial Equality (MIR) and will help the Ministry with capacity-building activities, technical expertise, knowledge sharing and other inputs for MIR's Ombudsman Department, including training of public servants who will work on the new phone channel (dial 138) to report cases of racism.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ4028 Institutional capacities strengthened to reopening the São Cristóvão Palace of the Brazilian National Museum
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.2 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas para ampliar o direito à participação, ao controle social e ao diálogo social, contemplando mulheres, crianças e adolescentes, e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, no que concerne à governança inclusiva, planejamento, orçamento e prestação de serviços, com foco na intersetorialidade das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: This project aims to support the Ministry of Education (MEC) and the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ) in the process of implementing the museography necessary for the reopening of the São Cristóvão Palace of the National Museum, in 2026. The museography includes an integrated project management and the production and assembly of the Historical Circuit, part of the long-term exhibitions of the museum, and the temporary galleries exhibition.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 570BRZ5005 Regulatory frameworks strengthened to protect youth in the digital environment
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.1 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas de participação no controle, desenvolvimento e aplicação do marco legal de transparência, integridade, combate à corrupção, e de inovações tecnológicas no setor público, ampliando a transparência e o acesso a dados e informações sobre a oferta e a qualidade dos serviços prestados à população, e desenvolvendo soluções, baseadas nos direitos humanos e na igualdade de geração, gênero, raça e etnia, para os desafios nacionais e locais.
planEntities.description: The project aims to contribute to the democratic debate on the governance and regulation of digital technologies in Brazil, with a particular focus on the comprehensive protection of the rights of children and adolescents. It aims to facilitate the exchange of regulatory and normative implementation experiences among members of the Brazilian Executive, Legislative, and Judiciary branches and their international counterparts, as well as academics and civil society representatives. The activities include meetings, technical visits, seminars, report production, and events. The goal is to generate practical knowledge on the impact of regulatory models and their respective implementations, strengthen national policymaking, deepen global knowledge exchange, and promote strategic international collaboration to address shared challenges in the best interests of all children and adolescents.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 586RLA2002 South-South cooperation on integrated water management enhanced in the LAC region
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.4 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas sobre soberania e segurança alimentar e nutricional, seguranças sanitária, hídrica, de saneamento básico, energética e climática, combate à poluição e redução e tratamento sustentável adequado dos resíduos, para que também respondam aos desafios das áreas urbanas, rurais e suas periferias, e com perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia, respeito aos saberes e modos de vida dos povos que vivem nos territórios e foco nos grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade.
planEntities.description: The objective of the project is to promote training and integration in Latin America and the Caribbean for the management of water resources and the regulation of sanitation. The expected results include: i) the implementation of an education and training plan in water resources and sanitation management over five years; ii) holding training workshops to strengthen integrated water resources management; iii) the implementation of innovative capabilities for water resources management; and iv) strengthening Latin American integration in regional water resources management. Furthermore, an evaluation and a seminar are planned at the end of this Project.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1158 Advanced studies in hospital management implemented and advanced
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.4 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de saúde, soberania e segurança alimentar e nutricional fortalecidas, com foco na produção ambientalmente adequada, no acesso igualitário, na qualidade e na ação intersetorial, de forma inclusiva e protetiva para todas as pessoas, em especial as que estão em situação de vulnerabilidade, a partir das perspectivas de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e do respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to develop and implement innovative and structuring methodologies dedicated to the training of health professionals, teaching, research and innovation, with the aim of strengthening the Unified Health System (SUS) and facing the complex challenges of hospital management in the Brazilian context. To this end, the aim is to establish and develop the Center for Advanced Studies in Hospital Management (CEAGH), whose activities include improving professional training, continuing education, producing solutions, science and innovation for hospital and health system management in the Ebserh Network. The project includes drawing up an action plan for the CEAGH, involving relationships with various audiences, strategic partnerships, activities, resources, costs and sources of income. In addition, it aims to strengthen CEAGH's teaching, research, scientific and technological production capabilities through innovative models, as well as improving teaching capacity and technical-scientific and administrative management through advanced studies and training strategies.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ2051 Environmental preservation and social well-being strengthened through effective port's management
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: This sub-output aims to promote the sustainable development of the ports of Rio de Janeiro and Itaguaí, seeking to reconcile port activity with environmental preservation and the promotion of social well-being. It aims to support the consolidation of a policy of social and environmental responsibility with regard to the territories and their surroundings, identifying and implementing actions and practices that contribute to the sustainability of the ports, considering aspects such as energy efficiency, waste management, preservation of local ecosystems, environmental awareness and education, among others. It also aims to contribute to the implementation of mitigation and adaptation actions, with a view to meeting the objectives of the Paris Agreement and within the current framework of action on climate change.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3058 Tools, methodologies, and indicators improved to better implement  violence policies targeting children and youth in the Rio Grande do Sul state
planEntities.parentName: 2.2.2 Capacidades institucionais nacionais e subnacionais fortalecidas para a prevenção e o enfrentamento às múltiplas formas de violências contra grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial as violências baseadas em gênero, no racismo e no território e as que sofrem múltiplas e agravadas formas de discriminação, com atuação, de forma articulada, entre Poderes, Entes da Federação e a sociedade civil.
planEntities.description: The objective of this cooperation project is to strengthen instruments, methodologies, and indicators that support policies for the protection and prevention of violence against children and young people, as well as the promotion of a culture of peace in the priority areas of the RS Seguro COMunidade Programme, with the overarching goal of enhancing community safety.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ3061 Social Protection policies ensured for families of the Rio Grande do Sul State
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.1 Capacidades de gestão em políticas públicas de proteção social, erradicação da pobreza, combate à fome e de empoderamento econômico fortalecidas, considerando aspectos demográficos e sociais regionalizados, com foco nos territórios, grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, em especial jovens e mulheres que sofrem discriminações múltiplas, priorizando o desenvolvimento de estratégias de inclusão socioeconômica, incluindo a redução das desigualdades no mercado de trabalho, estimulando níveis de qualificação, empregabilidade e de renda igualitários entre homens e mulheres, abrangendo também trabalhadoras domésticas, o setor de cuidados, trabalhadores rurais e trabalhadores de aplicativos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to provide technical support to enable and improve the implementation of the Família Gaúcha Programme, working to combat extreme poverty, vulnerabilities and the social risks arising from them. The project aims to build capacities, develop analyses, and train teams to develop the Família Gaúcha Programme, which seeks to implement the state social assistance policy, organised by the Unified Social Assistance System (SUAS), mainly the Basic Social Protection services, focusing on the Family Protection and Integral Care Service (PAIF), as well as strengthening social work with families, aiming at social protection and access to social rights. This will be achieved through the monitoring of families selected by intersectoral committees at the local and state levels, and through monitoring and evaluation using a digital system, together with the provision of services to selected families.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 218BRA2001/218BRA2002 MPTF Legal Amazon (State of Acre) Environmental Resilience in the Brazilian Amazon
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: The program focuses on developing actions to strengthen governance, forest restoration, water security and bioeconomy, proposing socio-environmental resilience in two state-managed sustainable use conservation units - EPAs of Lake Amapá and Igarapé São Francisco. In this socio-environmental resilience program, UNESCO and the State of Acre address the capacity of communities and ecosystems for adaptation, recovery and transformation in the face of extreme events with environmental, social and economic impacts.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 218BRA2000 MPTF Legal Amazon Outcome 3: Promoting Inclusive Territorial Governance and Indigenous multilingual education
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: Within the scope of the UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund for the Sustainable Development of the Brazilian Legal Amazon, this outcome aims to promote inclusive territorial governance and strengthen indigenous multilingual education across the Biosphere Reserves in Amazonas, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, and Maranhão. It focuses on structuring integrated governance systems through partnerships with state authorities and organizing national and local workshops to empower women, youth, and indigenous leaders with skills in collaboration, governance, and communication. Additionally, the initiative will produce technical studies to enhance engagement strategies and develop educational materials in five indigenous languages, covering health, traditional knowledge, technology access, and STEM inclusion for girls. To foster representation and participation, the project will also establish thematic networks for women, youth, and indigenous peoples, ensuring their active role in decision-making and sustainable development within the Legal Amazon.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 570BRZ2050 Reforestation programmes supported in the biosphere reserve of Mata Atlantica
planEntities.parentName: 3.1.1 Capacidades de gestão e governança fortalecidas para políticas e programas de restauração de zonas degradadas, conservação da biodiversidade e uso sustentável de ecossistemas terrestres, aquáticos e costeiros, com maior participação, inclusive na dimensão territorial, dos povos indígenas, dos povos e comunidades tradicionais e das populações do campo, floresta e águas em geral, respeitando o conhecimento tradicional e valorizando e remunerando, conforme adequado, os serviços ambientais por eles prestados
planEntities.description: This four-year project covers an area comprised by three Brazilian states (Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and Espirito Santo), a highly populated territory marked by a rich biodiversity and important natural and cultural assets of the Brazilian heritage. The area is home to the Brazilian Biosphere of Mata Atlantica and has also an intense connection with the Ocean with large ports and oil industries based in the region, important fishery centers, pristine islands and other well-protected forest and marine ecosystems. As todays’ “economic center” of Brazil, with large urban centers advancing over the Mata Atlantica biome, the region is also marked by successful cases of conservation programmes allying economic development to environmental programmes. It is indeed one of the few areas of Brazil where original large forests of Mata Atlantica remain untouched, this thanks to governmental laws and a combined effort of local NGOs involved in the preservation of the unique characteristics of the region. The project is therefore indeed to explore existing synergies with a qualified network of local partners (UNESCO biosphere reserves, UNESCO chairs, well-known NGOs with large presence in the territory etc) to mitigate the negative effects of an old development paradigm. The project will enable sustainable education programmes, reforestation activities and other science-based strategies (carbon sequestration, blue economy etc) as viable alternatives to local inhabitants.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ4029 Democracy promoted in Brazil through heritage and memory
planEntities.parentName: 4.1.2 Instituições públicas e da sociedade civil com capacidades fortalecidas para ampliar o direito à participação, ao controle social e ao diálogo social, contemplando mulheres, crianças e adolescentes, e grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, no que concerne à governança inclusiva, planejamento, orçamento e prestação de serviços, com foco na intersetorialidade das políticas públicas.
planEntities.description: The International Technical Cooperation Project between UNESCO and the Federal Supreme Court (STF) of Brazil aims at the physical expansion, the development of the new exhibition project and the curatorial management of the Minister Sepúlveda Pertence Museum, of the Federal Supreme Court (“STF Museum” ), with the purpose of promoting democratic values, human rights, constitutional culture and citizenship in Brazil. The partnership between UNESCO and the STF will transform the STF Museum into a reference cultural center for the promotion of memory and education for democracy, with the general aim of safeguarding and disseminating the history of Brazilian constitutionalism, the achievement of fundamental and human rights and the creation of the Federal Supreme Court itself. This project aims to bring the Court closer to society and expand understanding of the importance of the Constitution and the STF for the protection of rights and the democratic regime.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1159 Basic Education strengthened in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project focuses on contributing to the strengthening of programs implemented by Basic Education Secretariat of the Brazilian Ministry of Education (SEB-MEC) aimed at improving the quality of basic education in all its stages, considering the specificities of the various audiences and teaching modalities, access, permanence, learning, and equity. In this context, the project intends to provide technical inputs for the improvement of national educational public policies aimed at enhancing the quality of learning and the appreciation and qualification of teachers, ensuring equal conditions for access and permanence in basic education in line with the full development of the person, the exercise of citizenship, and preparation for the world of work. Among the planned activities are: conducting diagnostics to support the formulation of guidelines, protocols, and directives for basic education, mapping and disseminating good pedagogical practices within the scope of basic education curricula, developing innovative educational methodologies for the training of education professionals, supporting the conception of monitoring and evaluation strategies, and developing materials for technical improvement within the scope of SEB/MEC’s priority programs.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1160 Education modernized and improved in the state of São Paulo
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project focuses on providing technical assistance for consolidating the teaching-learning policies and guidelines of the São Paulo State Department of Education. Activities include technical assistance to strengthen São Paulo's Professional Education Program and the expansion of state-level technical professional education, the consolidation of the use of educational technologies in the schools of the state education network, with the improvement of pedagogical practices, curricula, carrying out of diagnoses, identification of good pedagogical practices and the development of innovative educational materials, content and methodologies, as well as the improvement of the management capacity of educational programs and the support of training programs.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1161 Sustainable Educational Public Policies enhanced through innovation and equity
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This project aims to support the Ministry of Education (MEC) in the innovation, formulation, implementation, and enhancement of public educational policies that promote transformative, equitable, inclusive, and quality education. It is aligned with the country’s needs and takes into account its full regional, local, economic, cultural, and social diversity. Grounded in UNESCO’s principles of education as a right and a common good, as well as the guidelines of the new National Education Plan (PNE), the project will foster the production of data, studies, and innovative actions to inform education policies focused on improving learning outcomes, reducing inequalities, and strengthening institutional capacities.

planEntities.name: UNESCO 914BRZ1162 Inclusive and Quality Education promoted as a human right in the city of Leme, São Paulo
planEntities.parentName: 2.1.3 Capacidades de gestão de políticas públicas de educação de qualidade, acesso, permanência e aprendizagem fortalecidas, proporcionando, com equidade, proteção e inclusão de grupos e pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, e oportunidades de aprendizagem ao longo da vida, a partir da perspectiva de geração, gênero, raça e etnia e respeito aos direitos humanos.
planEntities.description: This International Technical Cooperation project between the Municipal Education Department of Leme and UNESCO aims to strengthen the educational policies of the Municipal Education Network of Leme, contributing to the improvement of strategies focused on inclusion, equity, and human rights in the context of providing quality education. The actions include the development of management methodologies, studies, diagnostics, cooperation, and exchange of experiences, as well as the continuous training of education professionals. The objective is to enhance management skills and disseminate innovative pedagogical practices, promoting inclusive and quality education for all students, with better learning outcomes and the promotion of human rights.

The initiative also entails the development of a protocol to combat gender-based violence, ethnic-racial discrimination inside and outside football stadiums and other socialization spaces; Develop communication strategy, pieces and media content to increase the visibility of the topic in stadiums and among the sports community

planEntities.description:
Capacity development in partnership with the Ministry of Racial Equality and the National Secretariat of Youth to deliver sustained results pertaining to the Juventude Negra Viva Plan, which promotes the rights of black youth in Brazil. This project also aims at the promotion of the Youth Agenda and the participation of Youth in strategic policy dialogue spaces. 
The initiative supports the development of a territorialization, management, monitoring and evaluation methodology for the implementation of the "Plano Juventude Negra Viva" (Black Youth Alive Plan), as well as the production of data and evidence on the impact of actions developed to promote the rights of black youth in Brazil.
